symbols.reasoning: Validates nonempty normalized phone/name, captures trimmed name and now, then reads/creates customer with unique phone race recovery. Phase1 Save can persist customer before phase2 failure. Phase2 begins transaction, locks customer anchor then address range, updates name and merges geographic match, refreshes instructions/service/LastUsed or inserts new address, Save/Commit. Correct per-customer lock serialization prevents same-address concurrent duplicates when all writers follow path. Name updates last writer wins intentionally; now captured before lock may make UpdatedAt/LastUsed go backward under paused scheduling, an ordering lead not monetary loss. Final address read after commit can include sibling newer data; DTO is current aggregate, not exact command snapshot.
